title: refactor(driver-sql): move the data-lifecycle rotation sub-banner's movable members out of sql-driver.ts into sql-driver-schema-sync.ts (#25521 cut 17)

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XHoLU3ToFTmB9h8qjF9hUi5)_

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:把 `sql-driver.ts` 里「数据生命周期轮转」小节中能搬的五个方法体(轮转器 `ensureRotation` 及它调用的分片键 `rotationShardKey`、视图列清单 `rotationColumnList`,三条建表路径共用的内置列冲突告警 `warnBuiltinColumnCollisions`,联邦外部对象的免 DDL 注册 `registerExternalObject`)原样搬进已有的 `sql-driver-schema-sync.ts`;类上五个方法全部保留,只把方法体转交过去,`SchemaSyncHost` 按需增补成员。
- **为什么改**:#25521 拆分超大文件的第 17 刀;重新测量后这是收益最大且不碰任何系列限制的区域,`sql-driver.ts` 减少 125 行。
- **风险与回滚**:纯搬移,无行为变化;三个 SQL 驱动的测试两端逐条一致,公开类型声明哈希不变,121 条探针读数两端一致(仅 8 条栈顶接收者名不同)。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**:`sql-driver-schema-sync.ts` 头注释新增的第 17 刀段落与 `SchemaSyncHost` 新增成员;`sql-driver.ts` 中五个方法的转交桩;`sql-driver.ts` 顶部两处 import 的改动。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql exec vitest run src/sql-driver-rotation.test.ts src/sql-driver-ddl-gate.test.ts src/sql-driver-external-columnmap.test.ts src/sql-driver-shard-tenancy-opt-out.test.ts`,预期全部通过。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Cut 17 of the `sql-driver.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). The claim is `6446054910`. The cut opens with a fresh seam table (below), taken on `origin/main` `785a7c3b3e`, and takes the area cut 16 priced next and that still pays best without breaking a series limit: the **movable members of the data-lifecycle rotation sub-banner** (`Schema Sync › Data-lifecycle rotation`). Their bodies move unedited into the **existing** seam module `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-schema-sync.ts`, the module cut 12 already moved six members of this same sub-banner into, through its host `SchemaSyncHost`:

- `ensureRotation`, the rotator: it inventories a rotation-managed table's shards, adopts a legacy base table as the current shard (and recovers when both exist), column-syncs the retained shards, drops the expired ones and rebuilds the `UNION ALL` read view;
- `rotationShardKey` and `rotationColumnList`, which it calls (the shard key of an instant, and the view's column list);
- `warnBuiltinColumnCollisions`, the #12015 warning the create, alter and shard paths share when a declared field collides with a builtin column;
- `registerExternalObject`, the DDL-free registration of a federated object.

No module-level declaration moves: none is read by these bodies alone. `declaredValueShapes` is also read by `registerManagedObjectMetadata`, which stays, so it gains a leading `export` in place and the module imports it. The three names of `./builtin-column-collision.js` (`undeliveredStorageAttributes`, `formatAttribute`, `type UndeliveredAttribute`) lose their last value reader in `sql-driver.ts`; the import there shrinks to `type undeliveredStorageAttributes`, which the staying docblock of `warnBuiltinColumnCollisions` links (a link-only import is a type import, erased from the build).

The change is move-only, and the card stays open for later cuts. There is no `docs/adr/**` edit, no `packages/spec/**` edit, no anchor entry change, no gate edit, no test edit and no new gate. Branch `claude/project-thread-0gietk` (the platform assigned it to this card thread, as the claim records). The move is one commit, `6b6ca4b01`, on `785a7c3b3e`, followed by one merge of `origin/main` (`83c4bd29f7`); the head is `3dcd74655b`.

**Net line count (the seat's rule).** `sql-driver.ts` goes from 18,646 lines to 18,521: **-125**.

- **Out:** the five bodies, 192 lines (87 + 67 + 28 + 7 + 3), and 4 import lines (the three-name `builtin-column-collision.js` import becomes one line).
- **In:** the five stub bodies, 68 lines (44 + 14 + 6 + 2 + 2), and 3 comment lines above the existing `sql-driver-schema-sync.js` import, whose one line gains the five names.
- `sql-driver-schema-sync.ts` goes from 1,653 to 1,914 lines (+261): the five functions, 20 new `SchemaSyncHost` members, three imports and a header paragraph.

**Path readers.** No test, script, doc, ADR or anchor entry reads any of the five bodies by path, so none is migrated (screen below).

**Serial with the file's in-flight PRs.** I read the file list of every open PR on `objectstack-ai/objectstack` at the start (27) and again before opening this one (26). None touches `sql-driver.ts`, `sql-driver-schema-sync.ts`, `turso-driver.ts`, `sqlite-wasm-driver.ts`, `check-tenant-chokepoint.mjs`, `check-object-def-param-keys.mjs` or a driver-sql anchor entry. #26556 (dependabot) touches only `driver-sql/package.json`.

In all, 3,323 lines (17.8%) are from the last 30 days.
- **Class shape.** `SqlDriver` spans lines 4244-18571 with 350 members: 243 instance methods, 13 accessors and 32 statics, all 32 private or protected.

### Pricing the areas

Eligibility is as cuts 11-16 defined it: an annotated return type or not public; no `getBuilder`, `this.FIELD.delete/insert/update(`, private-static, `super`, bare-`this` or `this`-write site; not `insertOnlyUpsertColumns`; not a member pinned in place (`createColumn`, `applyFilterCondition`, `formatInput`/`formatOutput`, `initObjects`, `ensureShardTable`, `computeTenantField`, `migrateMysqlDatetimeColumns`/`migrateMysqlTimeColumns`, `compileFilters`). Each area is priced as its stubs minus its bodies, then net of the module-level declarations only it reads (they would move along) and of its import edits.

## Why

### Why this area, as one area

- **One banner.** The five are the members of the class's own `Data-lifecycle rotation` sub-banner that can move. Cut 12 moved six other members of the same sub-banner (the SQLite backfills and the MySQL widening's reads and runner) into `sql-driver-schema-sync.ts`, so this cut puts them beside those, behind the host that already exists, instead of opening a new module.
- **It pays the most of any area that moves cleanly**, about 1.6 times the next one.
- **What stays, and why.**
  - `rotateShards` (its stub would cost as many lines as its body), `aliasShardBookkeeping` (its stub would cost more than its body), `ensureShardTable` (named by `check:object-def-param-keys`), `computeTenantField` (named by `packages/spec/liveness/object.json`), `computeAndRecordTenantField` and `registerManagedObjectMetadata` (each has a `this.FIELD.delete(` site, the tenant-audit series limit), `initObjects` (pinned), and `migrateMysqlDatetimeColumns`/`migrateMysqlTimeColumns` (each catch around a vocabulary callee reports through `logDurabilityFailure`, which `check:durability-log-level` resolves only within one file).
  - The accessors and the three one-line readers of `rotationStateByTable` stay; each stub would cost more than its body.
- **No series limit is touched.** None of the five builds through `getBuilder`, reads a static, has a `this.FIELD.delete/insert/update(` site, uses `super` or a bare `this`, or assigns to `this`. `registerExternalObject` is public with an annotated `void` return; the other four are protected with annotated returns. `check:tenant-chokepoint`'s D8 predicates, measured with its own `nullArmsOf`: **4 at base and 4 at head**, all in `sql-driver.ts`, 0 in the moved bodies (`registerExternalObject` names `tenantField` four times, as a value it stores, never as a predicate).
- **Durability gate.** The moved bodies have no `catch` clause. `check:durability-log-level --list` gives the same seams at both ends, line numbers aside (164 lines of output at each end).
- **Logger.** `ensureRotation` and `warnBuiltinColumnCollisions` and `registerExternalObject` write to the logger through `this.logger`, which the host passes as a getter, so each call keeps its receiver. `check:logger-receiver-detach` is green (below).
- **Subclasses.** `TursoDriver` and `SqliteWasmDriver` extend `SqlDriver` and override none of the five (`TursoDriver` calls the inherited `registerExternalObject`). Every stub keeps its signature and modifier, and every member a body calls is a late-bound closure on the instance (probe below).
- **Path readers, screened.** No script, test, doc or ADR names any of the five by a `sql-driver.ts#…` pointer or a `sql-driver.ts::…` key, and no `scripts/adr-anchors/**` record names them. `check-object-def-param-keys.mjs` cites `#ensureRotation` as a symbol anchor in prose; the method keeps its name and signature in `sql-driver.ts`, and the gate's output is byte-identical at both ends. The tests that read `sql-driver.ts` as text look for `createColumn`, the width constants, the INVALID_FILTER builders and log-call shapes, none of which moved. Prose mentions elsewhere (`turso-driver.ts`, `remote-transport.ts`, ADR-0015 and ADR-0062, the objectql federation tests) name `SqlDriver.registerExternalObject`, which is still true.

## The shape (#23050 shape B, as cuts 1-16 apply it)

- Each class method keeps its docblock and signature, byte-identical. Its body is now one host literal plus `NAME.call(host, ...)`, marked `[#25521 cut 17]`. `rotationShardKey` and `rotationColumnList` read no member of the driver, so their methods call the function directly. `ensureRotation` loses `async` and returns the moved function's own promise, as cut 12's methods do.
- The fields the bodies read (`knex`, `logger`, `rotationStateByTable`, `isSqlite` and the seventeen per-object bookkeeping maps) go as GETTERS that read the driver at call time; the methods (`ensureShardTable`, `aliasShardBookkeeping`, `rotationShardKey`, `rotationColumnList`, `computeAndRecordTenantField`, `isJsonField`) go as closures that call the method on the driver at call time. So a subclass override, an instance spy, or a field replaced after construction is still the one the body reaches.
- `SchemaSyncHost` grows by exactly the 20 members these bodies read that it did not list yet, each typed as the class member's indexed access, in the interface's sorted order (54 to 74 members). There is no cast, and no member becomes public.
- **Module imports added.** `aggregandColumnClass` (`@objectstack/core`); `FILE_REFERENCE_TYPES`, `NUMERIC_VALUE_TYPES`, `parseAutonumberFormat`, `resolveAutonumberFormat`, `type AutonumberToken` (`@objectstack/spec/data`); `formatAttribute`, `undeliveredStorageAttributes`, `type UndeliveredAttribute` (`./builtin-column-collision.js`); and `declaredValueShapes`, `NUMERIC_SCALAR_TYPES` added to the existing `./sql-driver.js` import. The module reads them only inside function bodies, so the import cycle stays evaluation-safe. `index.ts` names its exports one by one; the export lists below prove none of them leaks.
- **Comments.** The module header gains one `[#25521 cut 17]` paragraph saying what moved, what stayed and where each read declaration comes from. The `sql-driver.ts` import comment names cut 17 in 3 lines. Neither cites an `ADR-NNNN` letter. The line comments inside `registerExternalObject`'s body that link `{@link mediaFields}` and its siblings now name `SchemaSyncHost` members of the same names.
- **How the move was made.** A script produced it from the source text; nothing was retyped. Each body line is re-indented two columns; no body line starts inside a template literal. `registerExternalObject`'s one multi-line parameter type is re-indented the same way.

## Verification

### ADR anchors

- **The count.** `check:adr-anchors` counts **1898** decision-letter citations at base `785a7c3b3e` (a clean detached worktree) and **1898** at head, over 91 anchored files at both ends. Both runs exit 0.
- **Why equal.** No comment inside the moved bodies or the new header paragraph cites a decision letter. The stubs keep their docblocks, so every `ADR-…` mention in them stays in `sql-driver.ts`.
- **No entry needs a new home.** No anchor entry names a moved member. `check:adr-symbol-anchors`: 2687 resolve at both ends.
- **After the merge.** `main` moved under the cut, so I measured its tip `83c4bd29f7` against the merge head `3dcd74655b`: **1898** letters at both (91 anchored files, exit 0), and 2687 symbol anchors resolve at both.

### The published `.d.ts` does not change

This is measured under the series bar (ruling `6348891160`, item 1).

- **How each end was built.** `pnpm turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/driver-sql --force` at each end, against the same dependency tree. The base leg writes base `sql-driver.ts` and base `sql-driver-schema-sync.ts` into this worktree under an EXIT/INT/TERM trap that restores HEAD. The restore is proved by the HEAD blob hashes, an empty `git diff HEAD` and 0 status entries.
- **The hashes.** The raw sha256 of `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.mts` is the same at base and at head, `0f33bf3febaac3c7aa96f68a4226d752766b8203ab7acade523b69f9aaa44d74` (unchanged since cut 8), on the move commit and again on the merge head. These two are the dist's only declaration files (no chunk), so nothing was re-ordered and the declaration-reorder bar of ruling `6441032442` does not come into play.
- **Positive control.** I dropped `protected` from `ensureRotation` in the head `index.d.ts`. The result hashes to `7d72d5f631e8e134fe0cfc67e9fcaa78bc3cddd2b5702c2754502ec0bcff8987`, with `cmp` exit 1.
- **Export lists.** CJS `require` of each dist gives 59 names (sha1 `05757ce5ae` at both ends); the ESM export statement of the base and head `index.mjs` lists the same 59 names (sha1 `05757ce5ae` both). None of the five moved functions, `declaredValueShapes` or `SchemaSyncHost` is among them.
- **The head dist carries the move.** `.call(host` sites in `index.mjs` go from 61 at base to 64 at head (three host stubs; the two direct-call stubs have none).

### Move-only proof

The proof compares TypeScript compiler AST leaf tokens (JSDoc nodes skipped), base `785a7c3b3e` against head `6b6ca4b01`. It is a scratch script and is not committed.

| Moved body | Body tokens | Comments | Parameter tokens less `this` | Return type tokens | Body lines |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| `registerExternalObject` | 759 | 16 | 48 | 1 | 87 |
| `ensureRotation` | 557 | 14 | 57 | 24 | 67 |
| `warnBuiltinColumnCollisions` | 179 | 1 | 26 | 3 | 28 |
| `rotationShardKey` | 99 | 1 | 10 | 1 | 7 |
| `rotationColumnList` | 69 | 0 | 13 | 1 | 3 |

- **Each moved body.** In every row, 0 tokens differ and every comment is identical. Each body line is the base line less two leading spaces. `ensureRotation` is `async` at both ends; the other four are not.
- **The five stubs.** Leading trivia (the docblock), modifiers and the signature are identical to base (`ensureRotation` less `async`).
- **The class.** It has 350 members at both ends, in the same order, and the 345 unmoved members are byte-identical, trivia included.
- **Top level of `sql-driver.ts`.** 176 of 180 base statements are byte-identical; the other four are the class, `declaredValueShapes` (it differs from base by a leading `export` and nothing else, checked), and the two edited imports.
- **The module.** Its 34 base statements are all in the head module byte-identical except three: its first import (whose leading trivia is the header, which gained the cut 17 paragraph), the `./sql-driver.js` import (two names added) and `SchemaSyncHost` (20 members added). The head adds three imports and the five functions.
- **Result.** `PROOF OK`, exit 0.
- **Negative control.** Through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, I changed `week: 7 * 86_400_000` to `week: 8 * 86_400_000` in the module's `ensureRotation` (1 hit, checked on disk). The proof then reports `ensureRotation` as differing, prints `PROOF FAILED`, and exits 1. The restore was proved (blob equals HEAD, empty `git diff HEAD`).

### Tests

Each end ran under one `os-verify-lock` hold, after building that end's driver-sql dist. I compared the vitest JSON per test name and status, base `785a7c3b3e` against head `6b6ca4b01`, and then again on the merge head `3dcd74655b`. Every part's exit code was captured on its own (build, probe, three suites: all 0 at every leg).

| Suite | Base | Head | Lost / changed / added |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `@objectstack/driver-sql` | 4061 (3847 passed, 214 skipped; 248 files) | same | 0 / 0 / 0 |
| `@objectstack/driver-turso`, against that end's built driver-sql dist | 2526 (2492 passed, 34 skipped; 95 files) | same | 0 / 0 / 0 |
| `@objectstack/driver-sqlite-wasm` | 746 (746 passed; 39 files) | same | 0 / 0 / 0 |

On the merge head (it brings in `main` up to `83c4bd29f7`: 14 commits, none in `packages/drivers/**`), the three suites give the same totals and the same per-test statuses as base, 0 / 0 / 0 in each.

- **Type check and lint.** `tsc --noEmit -p .` in driver-sql exits 0 on the move commit and on the merge head. `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config packages/drivers/driver-sql` exits 0.
- **Late-binding probe.** A scratch script, not committed. It runs node against each end's built dist and prints 121 readings, each with the result or the error's message, `code`, `status`, own keys and top stack frame, the tables `sqlite_master` holds, the bookkeeping maps written, and the log lines:
  1. `rotationShardKey` over `day`, `week`, `month` and an unknown unit, across Sunday/Monday, month, year and leap-day edges, and a `NaN` instant;
  2. `rotationColumnList` with no fields, builtin names, an odd column name, and `null`;
  3. `warnBuiltinColumnCollisions` over the three phases and an unknown one, with no fields, a presentation-only collision, undelivered storage attributes and a `null` declaration;
  4. `ensureRotation` through `rotateShards` on SQLite across seven sweeps (new shards, the window, drops, rows written and counted through the view), weekly and monthly policies, the legacy base-table adoption, the partial-failure recovery (base table and current shard both present), a direct call, and a builtin-collision field on the shard path;
  5. `registerExternalObject` on SQLite, Postgres and MySQL drivers: every field class, `remoteName`/`remoteSchema` (warned and ignored on SQLite, stored elsewhere), a `columnMap` with a non-string entry, autonumber formats, a tenancy opt-out and its sticky re-registration, a declared tenant field, `sys_organization`, and bad input;
  6. a SUBCLASS overriding `rotationShardKey`, `rotationColumnList`, `ensureShardTable`, `aliasShardBookkeeping`, `computeAndRecordTenantField`, `isJsonField` and `warnBuiltinColumnCollisions`; instance spies on six of them; the logger, four bookkeeping maps and `rotationStateByTable` replaced after construction, and `knex` behind a getter (the new ones are the ones reached);
  7. bad arguments.
- **Probe result.** 113 of the 121 readings are identical, results, tables, maps and log lines included. The other 8 differ only in the top stack frame's receiver name, where bad input throws inside a moved body: `_SqlDriver.X` at base and `Object.X` (host stubs) or `X` (direct-call stubs) at head. That is shape B's receiver, the same at every earlier cut, and no test or consumer reads it. One reading depends on the calendar day (the boot shard `initObjects` creates on the real clock is dropped by the first pinned sweep); every leg ran on 2026-10-27. On the merge head the probe output is byte-identical to the move commit's.
- **Not run.** No ablation, because no tested behaviour changed.
- **`test:repo`.** Not run locally; it is CI's run on this PR.

### Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives **48** families for this diff, the same list on the move commit and on the merge head. I ran each one on its own and captured its exit code before any pipe.

- **Merge head `3dcd74655b`: 48 run, all 48 exit 0.** `--ran` reconciles: `48 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 48 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`, exit 0.
